integration_adjustments: Mount Central in the existing canonical boot/error boundary and root route
Reuse shared UI components and local Inter font; no upstream SSR or telemetry imported
Mark example account, devices, activity and storage as presentation data
Preserve existing app/service consumers and window code without mounting the previous Web page
Shared active window state and stable app nodes across Central/Desktop and responsive compact mode
One mounted bottom navigation in both views, with Start, fixed view toggle and shared open-app list
Full-height non-scrolling shared sidebar owns Start/view switch, with measured navigation overflow and running apps in the separate bottom dock
Horizontal Start/four-square view toggle and shared AccountCard matching user reference; quota/plan remain presentation fixtures
Notification icon placed alongside pinned Home in the same shared sidebar row
Start removed; single four-square view switch replaces Minimize All at the bottom dock right edge
Shared dock reduced to 40px; control height and workspace clearance derived from canonical CSS tokens
Maximized app uses the complete shared work-area track without outer margins or desktop header clearance
Central container-sized grid without page scrolling; responsive panel selection, bounded summaries and existing actions through overflow
Collapsible responsive sidebar, account bell beside settings, and icon-only Home overflow without visible footer labels
Home-footer ellipsis and More-modal branch removed explicitly; footer track only reserved for responsive Aura mode control
Collapse control moved out of sidebar content flow to a directional chevron on the divider edge
Single-line used/limit GB caption; compact rail shows derived usage percentage with full quota tooltip
Account card and Avatar consume shared demo user display identity; account title remains single-line with full-name tooltip
Edge chevron vertically aligned to the logo row using shared sidebar inset and header-height CSS tokens
Logo-aligned edge chevron gains opaque theme surface, contrasting border, larger heavier icon and accent hover for visibility
Neutral active window borders; automatic window focus does not paint an outline, keyboard focus remains visible; divider arrow aligned to Home using shared row geometry
Home-aligned divider control reduced to 24 by 32 pixels with a 16-pixel chevron; shared contrast tokens retained
Desktop header duplicate Brand removed; shared sidebar remains the desktop brand owner and header actions remain right aligned
Duplicate desktop profile and theme header removed; existing sidebar Settings opens canonical Appearance control, and desktop header clearance is zero
Central duplicated hero/mobile controls removed; sidebar Settings remains theme entry and mobile grid drops unused header track
Hero landscape visible at all widths; one theme-selected image replaces overlapping day/night nodes and removes legacy responsive hiding
Central greeting follows local time and shared demo user; date refreshes each minute and on window focus, independent of visual theme
Sidebar current destination derives from shared active visible window; Home no longer remains selected over an app, overflow reflects hidden current destination
All compact apps divide the available width equally without strip scrolling; narrow headers and content adapt inside each division, stable nodes and focus order retained
Compact titlebar reduced to a single 40px row with spaced 28px controls; below 260px secondary actions use shared accessible dropdown, driven by the same action descriptors
Window layer uses shared upper/lower grid tracks: regular app spans all columns above compact panes; panel collapse/expand/minimize reallocates height automatically without absolute app sizing
Shared window icon resolver consumes existing app/project metadata in dock and titlebar; dock minimized marker and current-window semantics derive from reducer state
Running-app labels hide only when measured natural widths exceed the dock; ResizeObserver/font readiness restore labels when space permits, accessible names and tooltips remain

Central narrow layouts consider available container height: tall areas stack all three existing summaries, short areas keep tabs; lower summaries and Aura modes depend on actual capacity, without a duplicate layout or page scrolling

Canonical Web identity/session/actions and read-only Spaces adapters feed one context; subject changes abort/reset catalogs and remount local session workspace, while same-subject refresh preserves app nodes

Removed demo user/subscription/storage/projects/activity/online devices from active Central; existing cards and destinations show explicit unavailable transports without removing future features or changing responsive geometry

Explicit active-Space choice and clear action reuse the Native domain selection service; session-only Web adapter holds a validated subject-bound record, while the service owns invalidation instead of duplicated composition reset

Central/Desktop and Appearance consume one mounted canonical preference-runtime/catalog and existing Web preference-store; direct localStorage/theme state and duplicate window theme callbacks removed, saved versus session-only persistence remains honest, approved palette/geometry retained
